points.point: 最強機會之一是以 CMX500 為核心的 Generative AI user experience testing，用 TTFT／TPS 量化 generative AI 應用的使用者體驗（R&S 與 China Mobile Research Institute, MWC Shanghai 2026）。
points.label: covered
points.why: CMX500 genAI UX, CMR, MWC 2026, TTFT/TPS stated

points.point: 該機會的差異化來自 signaling tester 能可控地配置網路與無線條件（network parameters、fading、latency、jitter、RF impairments），非 signaling RF tester 無此能力。
points.label: partial
points.why: lists controllable network/RF conditions but does not clearly say non-signaling cannot do this

points.point: 此 testbed 的宣稱價值包含支援 on-device generative AI 應用設計最佳化與 future network optimization 的 reference points。
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions on-device genAI optimization, omits future network optimization reference points

points.point: 第二個機會是 AI/ML air-interface 驗證：CMX500 被配置成 AI-enabled base station emulator，用於 two-sided AI model 的 AI-enhanced CSI feedback 驗證（KT / Qualcomm / R&S）。
points.label: missing
points.why: KT/Qualcomm/R&S AI-enabled base station emulator CSI feedback PoC absent

points.point: 該 PoC 的量化宣稱是相較非 AI 技術約 50% downlink throughput 提升，是支撐 5G-Advanced / 6G AI 驗證商機的主要證據。
points.label: missing
points.why: 50% downlink throughput gain and 5G-A/6G support absent

points.point: 第三個機會是把 AI 用在 signaling tester 的測試工作流本身：CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant 以 generative AI 與 NLP 協助生成、擴充與解釋 XLAPI scripts。
points.label: missing
points.why: CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant for XLAPI not discussed

points.point: 需求面證據：R&S AI Workplace 客戶問卷（Latest Update 2026-08-19）正在蒐集 virtual testing 與 AI-assisted, agentic test workflows 的需求、限制、工具整合與成功指標。
points.label: missing
points.why: R&S AI Workplace questionnaire evidence absent

points.point: 所有 AI 相關證據都是 PR／demonstration 層級，不是正式 test specification、standardized benchmark 或 product datasheet，不可當成已驗證規格或商機。
points.label: partial
points.why: notes PR/demo and non-spec limits for some items, not all referenced AI evidence

invented: Non-signaling 端則有兩類證據：AI server 供應鏈的高速互連、clock/noise、power、optical/SiPh bench test mapping 直接連到 AI server
AI server 高速通道 / PCB / connector / cable SI 測試 | Non-signaling bench / component test
AI server clock / jitter / phase noise / LDO noise 測試 | Non-signaling bench / component test
AI server power rail / multiphase DC / PI / BMS / motor driver 測試 | Non-signaling bench / component test
